biotools.summary: IsoPairFinder is a computational tool for biochemical pathway discovery using stable isotope tracing metabolomics, integrated into the GNPS2 ecosystem. It identifies pathway intermediates by analyzing paired isotope-labeled and unlabeled metabolomics data from gene-edited microbes.
